column1: # THE CORPUS (baker-4, 2026-09-27) — one cell per (map, collection, mood, quality) with an EDITOR oracle in refs/.
# Paths relative to --refs (…/tiny/lightmap-re/refs) unless absolute. word = the DayTime word the source copy gets before
# the bake (the oracle's own); dirs = full | N (--max-dirs N: frame-1 / layout rows only) | compare (no bake: the source IS
# our side — the CEILING cells compare two editor saves); kept = the reduced oracle's list (the editor survives only a map
# without the light-carrying items and the vegetation clusters — a reduced oracle is LAMP-LESS by construction, RE 14
# 2026-09-27); extra = extra bake flags, env:KEY=VAL tokens go to the bake's environment; ceiling = V2's editor-vs-its-own-
# re-bake identity on that map class (pwc-day's four saves 95.0–99.4 % lamp-less → 99; stpad Night vs nocache 60.1 % → 60).
# An empty oracle (-) = a fixed "no oracle" line of the matrix (RedIsland: the TitlePack refuses the collection; q1/q2:
# the editor refuses the quality). Order = the round-robin deal to the boxes (--box K --boxes N): heavy cells spread out.
# lamp / layout rows at one direction (frame 1 and the layout do not depend on the direction count) — the old guard rows;
# ST-Night-f1 (V2) = the stpad d1 cell's frame 1 (classcmp-f1.tsv); tiny16 stock-only = E's stock rule baseline (12 049/12 214)
# the CEILING cells (V2): two editor saves of one map against each other — no bake, the numbers the verdict is measured against
# the giants (~25 min each) — last, so they land on one box while the other finishes the small rows
# no oracle possible — fixed lines of the matrix (the TitlePack refuses a RedIsland map; the editor refuses q1/q2 computes)
